headline: Canadian Business Leaders Warn Immigration Cuts Cause Labor Shortages
summary: Business leaders across Canada report that recent immigration restrictions have gone too far, creating labor shortages and leaving companies struggling to recruit workers.
why: Labor force constraints can restrict operational capacity, elevate wage pressures, and weigh on corporate profit margins across multiple sectors.

impacts.name: Canadian Corporate Sector
impacts.why: Widespread labor shortages can constrain business growth and increase operational costs.
